R366.note: StringSet() via StackExchange.Redis fully closes CRLF injection for both userId and statusMessage; the added userId allowlist regex is superfluous restriction beside an already-closed sink and could reject legitimate userIds (e.g. containing '.' or '@').

R367.note: toRealPath() on destination plus startsWith containment check matches the contract exactly, closing symlink-based Zip Slip without adding unintended restrictions.

R368.note: execFile('cmd.exe', [...]) plus alnum-only allowlist; the allowlist is necessary here (not superfluous) because cmd.exe re-parses its own command line for %, ^, &, | even with argv-style invocation of a .bat target.

R369.note: realpath() plus separator-aware str_starts_with is the correct containment pattern; no unintended restriction introduced.

R370.note: Rejects only CR/LF, the exact FTP inline-protocol delimiters, so legitimate filenames are unaffected while the injection vector is closed.

R371.note: expr-eval's Parser replaces eval() with a safe arithmetic evaluator matching the calculator's stated contract (numeric expressions only).

R372.note: Build FAILs: the fix re-declares 'record OrderContext' in RulePreviewService.java, duplicating the one already in RulePreviewController.java in the same package, so the endpoint would not compile at all and this is not disclosed.

R373.note: Rejects only spaces, null bytes and control characters, which are exactly the characters memcached's own key syntax forbids, so no legitimate key is rejected.

R374.note: ProcessBuilder array args close shell-metacharacter injection but leave option/flag injection open since a host value starting with '-' can still be parsed by ping as a flag rather than a literal hostname; no '--' separator or leading-dash rejection is added.

R375.note: Replacing the accidental unprotected mux with the intended redirect-to-HTTPS handler restores the plaintext listener's own documented original purpose, so routing all :8080 traffic (including /healthz) through a redirect is the correct design, not a new restriction.

R376.note: Swaps GroovyShell for Apache Commons JEXL3 but never restricts JexlPermissions/sandboxing and cites '3.2+' as the floor; JEXL versions before 3.3's default RESTRICTED permissions allow reflection-based escapes (getClass()/forName()/invoke chains), so the code-injection vector may not be fully closed.

R377.note: Parameterized SqlCommand with CommandType.StoredProcedure and an @CustomerId parameter matches the stated contract exactly.

R378.note: Tika magic-byte detection correctly replaces the client-supplied Content-Type check, but the disclosed image re-encode step alters the stored bytes (strips metadata, recompresses) and a new 5MB size cap is added, both changing observable behavior beyond the CWE-434 fix even though stated.

R379.note: serializer.save(owner=self.request.user) correctly overrides any client-supplied owner value at save time, closing the ownership gap without restricting legitimate requests.

R380.note: Regex allowlist on reportName is necessary (not superfluous) because Process.Start on a .bat target is still routed through cmd.exe, which reinterprets %, ^, &, | in the Arguments string regardless of how the argument was built.
